title: VoiceMate public mode (no Internet Identity login required)

requirements.summary: Make the main app UI (Reminders and Messages) accessible immediately without an Internet Identity login gate.
acceptanceCriteria: When opening the app in a fresh browser session, the user can access Reminders and Messages without seeing a login gate screen.
No UI flow blocks usage due to missing authentication (e.g., no forced login prompts).

file_operations.description: Remove the unauthenticated landing/login gate and always render the main AppLayout with RemindersView/MessagesView on initial load; keep the existing ThemeProvider and Toaster wiring. Ensure no logic branches require identity before rendering the core UI.

Update reminders/messages queries to work in public mode by fetching shared/public data without depending on an authenticated principal; remove any dependency on identity-gated calls during queryFn execution so queries run successfully for anonymous users.

requirements.summary: Remove/disable login/logout controls and first-time profile setup UI so the interface reflects shared/public mode with no Internet Identity wording.
acceptanceCriteria: The header no longer shows a Login/Logout control.
The app does not prompt users to set up a profile name before using the app.
Any user-facing text referencing “Login with Internet Identity” or “Recipient’s Internet Identity Principal” is removed or replaced with public-mode wording in English.

file_operations.description: Remove the LoginButton from the header UI and adjust header layout accordingly; ensure the navigation between Reminders and Messages remains available and functional.
Remove ProfileSetupDialog gating and any profile-setup logic/conditions so users are never prompted to set a name before using the app.

Adjust the current-user helper to avoid implying authentication is required (e.g., ensure callers can safely use it when identity is absent and avoid encouraging login-dependent flows); keep it compatible with existing consumers.

requirements.summary: Update messaging and “send reminder as message” UX for shared/public mode so sending does not require entering Principal IDs and messages remain usable without a user principal.
acceptanceCriteria: The message composer does not require a recipient Principal ID field to send a message.
The “Send Reminder as Message” dialog does not require a recipient Principal ID field to send a reminder message.
Messages view remains usable without a user principal (e.g., it does not rely on per-user inbox/sent filtering that breaks without login).

file_operations.description: Remove the recipient Principal ID input and validation; update the form so it only collects message content (including voice input) and can send in public mode without requiring any authentication-related user input.
Remove the recipient Principal ID input and any related validation/help text (including references to Internet Identity); update copy to reflect shared/public sending behavior.

Update useSendMessage and useSendReminderAsMessage mutations to no longer require a recipient string from the UI; internally use a shared/public recipient strategy compatible with the backend interface and ensure message/reminder-message send actions work without Principal text input.

Remove per-user inbox/sent filtering that depends on the current principal; present messages in a public/shared-friendly way (e.g., show all messages or a non-principal-based grouping) so the view remains functional when identity/principal is absent.
Update list rendering to remove reliance on current principal for display logic; adjust any 'From/To' labeling and delete-button rules so the UI remains coherent in shared/public mode.
